title: Projection Entity
description: JSON Schema for Projection entity in customer workspace. Projections are thin workflow nodes that delegate field mapping to TransformationEngine.transformBatch, connecting source Data_Product output ports to Entity_Store input ports.

projection_id.description: Unique identifier for the projection workflow node

workflow_id.description: Workflow this projection node belongs to

projection_spec_id.description: Projection_Spec that defines the field mappings

name.description: Display name of the projection node (written by ProjectionWorkflowNode.activate)

source_data_product_ids.description: Source Data_Product IDs whose output ports feed this projection

status.description: Current status of the projection node

upstream_entity_id.description: Upstream node in the workflow graph (typically a Data_Product output port)

upstream_entity_type.description: Entity type of the upstream node

metadata.description: Additional metadata for the projection node

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when projection node was created

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when projection node was last updated

deleted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when projection node was deleted (soft delete)
